changes.title: Amazon WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances now supports ModifyVolume API
changes.detail: Amazon WorkSpaces Core Managed Instances now supports the ModifyVolume API, which lets you change volume size, volume type, IOPS, or throughput in place, without detaching the volume or restarting the instance. Previously, changing storage capacity or performance on a deployed managed instance required rebuilding it. With ModifyVolume, you can increase volume size up to 16,384 GiB, switch between supported Amazon EBS volume types, adjust IOPS for gp3, io1, and io2 volumes, and modify throughput for gp3 volumes. changes.title: AWS IAM Identity Center now supports cross-Region trusted identity propagation
changes.detail: Trusted identity propagation carries a user's identity with their request, so AWS services can grant permissions based on who the user is and their underlying group associations, and log that user's access for auditing. With cross-Region support, this identity context can now be propagated to AWS services running in different AWS Regions, giving you greater flexibility in how you architect and deploy across AWS Regions.
